node.title: Re: Geany IDE with Perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Here's a small thread on Geany (which is indeed a little simplistic, but I still like it), plus a couple other IDE possibilities with Perl integrated more tightly:

  • [id://1171185]
  • [id://11103226]
  • [http://padre.perlide.org/|Padre, the Perl IDE] (seems still somewhat maintained)
  • [https://www.activestate.com/products/komodo-ide/|ActiveState Komodo] (commercial, I think there's a free version)
  • [https://www.epic-ide.org/|Eclipse Perl Integration] (apparently unmaintained, though)
  • And of course one should not forget vim and emacs.
